name: World Athletics
body: HSTS is on, framing is limited, DMARC quarantines spoofed mail, and the start page reads without JavaScript. But 56 of the 58 images on the start page have no width or height, so the layout jumps as they load.
lesson: Set width and height, or a CSS aspect-ratio, on every image to reserve its space.
summary: worldathletics.org scores 70 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 275 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 275 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /records/competition-performance-rankings. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 9 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /news, /news/press-releases, /news/news, /news/reports and 5 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Security headers on the start page are missing on other pages
fix.evidence: HSTS on 3 pages, frame protection on 3 pages, X-Content-Type-Options on 3 pages, Referrer-Policy on 3 pages, out of 20 pages analyzed. Attackers pick the weakest page.
fix.fix: Set the headers once at the server, CDN, or host config so every response carries them.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
